description: This file defines a custom PDF class extending FPDF, including methods for drawing shapes, rotating, adding images, company info, and constructing complex PDF elements like tables, bubbles, and blocks. It appears to be part of a reporting or document generation module within a CRM system.

classes.name: PDF
classes.description: A custom class extending FPDF for advanced PDF generation with shapes, images, and complex layouts.

methods.name: RoundedRect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners.

methods.name: _Arc
methods.description: Draws an arc segment for rounded corners.

methods.name: Rotate
methods.description: Applies rotation transformation to the PDF content.

methods.name: _endpage
methods.description: Handles cleanup at the end of a page, resetting rotation.

methods.name: sizeOfText
methods.description: Calculates the number of lines needed for a given text and width.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the PDF at specified location.

methods.name: addCompany
methods.description: Adds company name and address to the PDF.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Creates a bubble block with a label and total.

methods.name: addTextBlock
methods.description: Adds a non-wrapped text block with a title.

methods.name: tableWrapper
methods.description: Draws a table wrapper with lines.

methods.name: addBubble
methods.description: Adds a bubble with a title and page number.

methods.name: addBubbleBlock
methods.description: Adds a bubble block with a title and page number.

methods.name: addRecBlock
methods.description: Adds a record block with data and title.

methods.name: addDescBlock
methods.description: Adds a description block with detailed data.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a horizontal line.

methods.name: addCols
methods.description: Adds columns to a table with formatting.

methods.name: addLineFormat
methods.description: Sets formatting for table columns.

methods.name: addProductLine
methods.description: Adds a product line to a table.

methods.name: addTotalsRec
methods.description: Adds a totals record section.

methods.name: watermark
methods.description: Adds a watermark text with rotation.
